name: Prosciutto-Mozzarella Garlic Bread
description: Garlicky, cheesy bread for soaking up aglio e olio.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix unsalted butter with garlic, fresh parsley, black pepper, a pinch of salt, and red pepper flakes.
Slice baguette in half lengthwise and spread the garlic butter on both cut sides.
Layer prosciutto on the bottom half, then fresh mozzarella.
Close the loaf, wrap it tightly in foil, and bake on a baking sheet 10-12 minutes.
Unwrap, open the loaf cut-side up, and broil until the cheese bubbles and the edges are golden, 1-2 minutes. Watch it closely.
